steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to this Snipe-IT app with username 'admin' and password 'bench-admin-pass'. Then verify you are signed in by reporting the page title or the logged-in user shown in the header.

02-find: Go to the Assets list (all assets) in this Snipe-IT app and find every asset whose NAME starts with 'Seed:'. Report for each one: the asset's name exactly as shown and its asset tag exactly as shown. Use the list view (you may need to search or filter for 'Seed:' and paginate through all results to be sure you got them all). Do not modify anything. Report the complete list.

03-create: In this Snipe-IT app, create a new Asset (go to Assets > Create New / Add Asset). Fill in: Asset Name = '{{runid}} Bench Asset', Model = 'Bench Laptop Model' (choose it from the searchable model dropdown - an actual option must be selected, not just typed), Status = 'Ready to Deploy' (choose from the status dropdown), Default Location = 'Bench Office' (choose from the location dropdown), Purchase Date = 2026-03-15. Fill any other required fields as needed but do NOT create new models, locations, or users. Submit the form and verify the asset was created successfully. Report the asset's name, model, status, location, purchase date, and the asset tag the app assigned (like BA-00012).

04-create: In this Snipe-IT app, go to the asset detail page for the asset named '{{runid}} Bench Asset' (asset tag {{03-create.asset_tag}}, at /hardware/4). Check this asset out to the USER named 'Bench Assignee' (choose 'Bench Assignee' from the searchable user dropdown in the checkout form - an actual option must be selected, not just typed; do not create a new user). In the Notes field of the checkout, enter the text 'Checkout note for run {{runid}}'. Submit the checkout. Then verify on the asset detail page that the asset is now checked out to Bench Assignee and the checkout note is recorded in the asset's history. Report the assignee shown, the checkout note text shown, and the asset tag.
